summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Klinik Kana repair-management app (localStorage-backed mock). Covered auth (admin/teknisi/kasir), dashboard KPIs, sidebar RBAC, customer CRUD + WA link, sparepart CRUD + low-stock filter, repairs list + status filters, ticket creation on /repairs/new, repair detail (status workflow, sparepart add w/ bill total update, WA send link), reports & users pages, logout, unauth redirect, role restrictions (direct-URL access), and mobile hamburger. All 22 checks executed passed after correcting the test method for the repair-brand <select>.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — Emergent dev overlay wraps dynamic <option> text in a <span>. Cosmetic only, functionality unaffected; may originate from tooling rather than app code.

critical_code_review_comments: RepairNew.jsx line 62 uses <select data-testid="repair-brand"> while other similar fields are <input>. Testing agents/scripts may assume input; consider documenting or unifying.
Console shows hydration warning about <span> inside <option> on RepairNew — verify this is only the Emergent dev instrumentation and not shipped to production build.
seed_data_creation: Created via UI: customer TEST_Customer_Q (628123456789), sparepart TEST_PartX (SKU TSTPX01), and one repair ticket (KK-2608-001 assigned to seeded customer). All persisted in browser localStorage only.
test_credentials: admin/admin123, teknisi/teknisi123, kasir/kasir123 (from problem statement; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is localStorage-only. Note: [data-testid=repair-brand] is a <select>, use select_option not fill. Ticket numbering may increment across runs. Role restriction test uses demo-teknisi / demo-kasir quick-fill buttons on login page; both correctly hide restricted nav items and /users direct URL redirects to /dashboard for teknisi. Mobile viewport (390x844) shows btn-open-sidebar which opens the drawer.
